subject.title: fix(qqbot): bound gateway websocket handshake waits at 30s

question: Should QQBot unconditionally abort opening WebSocket handshakes after 30 seconds and reconnect, including for slow proxy or TLS paths?
rationale: Source and loopback proof establish the stalled-handshake bug and the patch is technically sound, but repository policy treats a new fail-closed transport default as an upgrade-sensitive operational choice that automated review should not approve.

options.title: Approve the 30-second bound
options.body: Accept the bounded reconnect behavior as the QQBot default and integrate it with the payload-bound change in the same factory.

options.title: Choose a different fixed budget
options.body: Replace 30 seconds with an owner-selected transport budget and update the focused assertions and loopback proof accordingly.

options.title: Pause for factory integration
options.body: Wait for the payload-bound PR to land, then rebase and review the combined constructor options before merging.

recommendation.title: Approve the 30-second bound
recommendation.body: Accept the bounded reconnect behavior as the QQBot default and integrate it with the payload-bound change in the same factory.
